pm.test('Refresh token cookie: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict', () => { const cookie = (pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').toLowerCase(); pm.expect(cookie).to.include('refreshtoken='); pm.expect(cookie).to.include('httponly'); pm.expect(cookie).to.include('secure'); pm.expect(cookie).to.include('samesite=strict'); });

const decodeJwt = token => { let part = token.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'); while (part.length % 4) { part += '='; } return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(part)))); };
pm.test('Tokene yra naudotojo ID ir sesija', () => { pm.expect(claims.sub).to.eql(String(body.user.id)); pm.expect(claims.sid).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Access token galioja trumpai (≤ 15 min.)', () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.be.at.most(15 * 60));
